blocks.title: »hobCheck«
blocks.text:
The universal measuring machine for
comprehensive checks on gear cutting tools

Request Information Now

blocks.body:
ZOLLER’s »hobCheck« universal measuring machine opens up unprecedented options for the fully automatic and cost-effective complete measurement of gear cutting tools, threading tools, and cutting tools of all types.

Benefit from precise measurement results—the swivelling »orthoScan« optic carrier guarantees distortion-free measurement of the tooth contour for pitched tools.

Request a 1:1 consultation with an expert now

Calibrating measuring machines on-site using certified test specimens and reference standards is an important part of E. ZOLLER GmbH & Co. KG’s quality assurance process—this ensures reliable measurement results and the high precision of your products in accordance with applicable standards.

spots.label: »»eQ«« One-Hand Control Handle
spots.text:
»»eQ«« One-Hand Control Handle

Ergonomic One-Handed Control Handle »»eQ««

Ergonomic one-hand control handle »»eQ«« (ergonomic and quick)—for effortlessly moving the optic carrier to the correct position along the Z-axis and the X-axis. The button with the Solutions icon can be configured with additional practical functions, making operation even simpler and more convenient.

spots.label: »orthoScan«
spots.text:
»orthoScan«

»orthoScan« Swivelling Multisensor Optic Carrier

»orthoScan« Swivelling Multisensor Optic Carrier – always finds the perfect perspective for the tool. This allows the cutting edge geometries of pitch tools, such as thread drills or hob cutters, to be measured via transmitted light without distortion.

spots.label: Z- and X-axes: Manual/CNC
spots.text:
Z- and X-axes: Manual/CNC

Z- and X-axes: Manual/CNC

Z- and X-Axes (manual/CNC)—these high-precision, smooth-running linear axes serve for rapid and fine positioning of the measuring optics relative to the tool cutting edge. Whether operated manually for spot checks using the »»eQ«« one-hand control handle or CNC-controlled for fully automatic processes, these axes enable safe, fast, and convenient measurement execution.

spots.label: incident light camera
spots.text:
incident light camera

Incident light camera with Multi-LED segment illumination

Incident light camera with Multi-LED segment illumination and CNC swiveling device—for inspection and automatic measurement of tool geometries on the circumference, in the chip space, and on the end face. It is simple to enter the target parameters in the Measuring program dialog, and each measurement parameter is automatically measured and recorded: rake angle, radial relief angle, Groove contour, chamfer width, and many other geometries. The high-performance LEDs, segmented into eight areas, are automatically controlled by the measuring system and ensure optimal lighting of the surface through automatic intensity control—for high precision and repeatability.

board

board

Practical board—holds adapter tools posts, adapters, tools, and intermediate sleeves.

spots.label: Software »Pilot 4.0«
spots.text:
Software »Pilot 4.0«

Software »pilot 4.0«

Software »Pilot 4.0« – is intuitive, provides an overview, and enables operators to perform reliable measurements. It offers a uniform user interface across all ZOLLER systems—including ZOLLER TMS Tool Management Solutions. The software’s modular design allows for customer-specific adjustments that can be implemented quickly.

spots.label: Pneumatics tailstock
spots.text:
Pneumatics tailstock

Pneumatics tailstock

Pneumatics tailstock – allows for holding long, thin tools as a counter-center and for clamping between centers. It features a high-precision, rotating tip. The very smooth quick-adjustment mechanism allows for precise positioning at the tool center, and the automatic pressure build-up ensures that tools are held securely without warping.

spots.label: »Cockpit« Control Unit
spots.text:
»Cockpit« Control Unit

»Cockpit« Control Unit

Separate »»cockpit«« control unit—provides space for a keyboard and mouse, as well as storage for label and laser printers, scanners, and tools. The 24-inch TFT color monitor is adjustable in height and inclination, making software use as comfortable as possible. This allows each operator to set up their workplace in just a few simple steps.

spots.label: High-Precision »Spindle »ace««
spots.text:
High-Precision »Spindle »ace««

High-Precision »»ace« Spindle«

»»ace«« high-precision spindle – guarantees μm-accurate mounting and clamping of all types of tools and holders. Adaptation to many tool holder systems is ensured by the universal adapter tool post changing system. The CNC drive with autofocus and a precise Angle measuring system provides automatic focusing on the tool cutting edge and for holding the Cutting contour.

spots.label: Sturdy Machine Table
spots.text:
Sturdy Machine Table

Sturdy Machine Table

Sturdy machine table—the foundation of the device: The computer, electronics, and pneumatic elements are housed here in an industrial-grade, service-friendly design, with everything neatly laid out and spaced to ensure optimal accessibility and ventilation.

blocks.body:
With ZOLLER »hobCheck«,« you can measure both contact and non-contact quantities using transmitted and incident light: Equipped with a CNC-controlled swivelling optic carrier and an electronic measuring sensor, transmitted and reflected light image processing, parameters such as tooth profile, radial run-out/wobble, pitch, and many more can be measured automatically on hob cutters in accordance with DIN 3968.

ZOLLER Multi-sensor technology »ace« high-precision spindle

blocks.title: Multi-sensor technology
blocks.text: The ZOLLER »pilot 4.0« software handles all calculations, positioning operations, and the assignment of sensors to the respective measuring task. The evaluation of tooth profiles and measured values, the calculation of quality grades, and the graphic logging of results are performed fully automatically.

blocks.body:
Quality management requirements are constantly increasing. That is why you need to be able to rely on the consistent measurement deviations of your machines. In ZOLLER measuring machines, length measurement errors are determined using high-precision Calibration standards made of Borofloat® glass in accordance with the DIN EN ISO 10360 standard. In accordance with this standard, at least three measurement sequences (25,326 relationships) are performed. This procedure documents the two-dimensional accuracy of ZOLLER measuring machines and ensures traceability at all times.

One-dimensional Two-dimensional

blocks.title: Two-dimensional
blocks.text: Based on DIN EN ISO 10360, Exy = 3.0 μm + (L/250 mm) μm

blocks.title: One-dimensional
blocks.text: According to VDI/VDE 2617, Ex = 1.5 μm + (L/300 mm) μm

blocks.body:
Manufacturing and measurement of gear cutting tools is an extremely demanding task that requires state-of-the-art technology. The ZOLLER »hobCheck« delivers this unique innovative strength down to the finest detail and, thanks to its mechanical design and intelligent clamping technology, ensures the outstanding quality of your tools.

The ZOLLER Inspection & Measuring Solution proves what many claim: quality.

blocks.header: We stand for precision in action
blocks.body:
Thanks to the intelligent combination of image processing technology, CNC axes, and a measuring sensor, all key parameters can be measured fully automatically. The distortion-free measurement and checks on pitch tools and precision tools of all types make ZOLLER »hobCheck« a true all-around genius.
